history.body: Hi, my partner and I are comparing homes around Seberang Jaya. I work from home a few days a week and need a quiet separate room for video calls. Could Pearl’s three-bedroom layout work well for us? I also saw a dated starting-price reference of around RM302k, which may be within our range.

Yes, it could be a practical fit: Pearl’s Type A is 900 sq ft with three bedrooms, so you could use one as a dedicated work room rather than taking calls in the shared living and dining area. That gives you a separate space, though I can’t promise it will be acoustically quiet—the information I have doesn’t confirm sound insulation or which room would be quietest. Looking at the floor plan or seeing the layout in person would help you judge the separation; I’d be happy to help arrange a viewing if you’d like.

That is the sort of setup I’m looking for—having a separate room would be better than taking calls beside the dining table. I’d like to see the floor plan to understand where the room sits. If it looks workable, I’d be interested in viewing it, but I’m not ready to book a time yet.

That makes sense—a separate room could give you a place for calls away from the dining area. I can confirm Type A has three bedrooms, but the information I have doesn’t show where each room sits, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll request the approved floor plan so you and your partner can check the layout. No need to book a viewing now; if it looks workable, we can discuss one then.
